title: Admit PR evidence reviewed on an identical tree
body:
Two operator D10 exceptions on 2026-10-29 (#135 message-only rewrite, #474 merge of an identical-tree base) re-ran full panels on trees that already had a PASS record (00fcafd^{tree}=0b2c2d1^{tree}, 9cade94e^{tree}=4073c909^{tree}). Independent review and process judges ranked binding acceptance to the commit SHA instead of the tree as a top cost driver.
Acceptance: PR admission accepts a complete PASS (or recorded override) record whose reviewed head has exactly the requested head's tree and the same series, while trailers, base ancestry and CI are still verified on the exact head; a frozen observer fails on the base by assertion and passes on the head. No change to the two-attempt budget.
